name: weapon
title: New weapon
summary: A new firearm built on a vanilla one: its own class and textures on the vanilla model, the vanilla magazines and attachments, and a loot entry.

parent.help: Vanilla weapon the new one inherits

attachment.help: Vanilla attachment for the attach check; it must fit a slot of the parent

magazine.help: Vanilla magazine the weapon must accept

classes.name: {item}
classes.notes: scope 2. Its script class is the parent's, so no script is needed.

files.what: Add {parent_addon} to requiredAddons[] and the {item} class to CfgWeapons.

tasks.task: Add class {item} : {parent} to CfgWeapons with scope 2, displayName and descriptionShort. Set hiddenSelectionsTextures for {parent_selections} to the new texture. Add {parent_addon} to requiredAddons[].
Make {item_lower}_co.paa from the user's PNG or TGA source with /dayz-pack-texture, laid out like the {parent} texture.
tasks.done: The .paa exists at the path T1 put in hiddenSelectionsTextures.

tasks.task: Add a types.xml entry for {item} with /dayz-edit-types, starting from the vanilla {parent} entry.
tasks.done: The entry exists and min is not above nominal.

checks.feature: The weapon exists in the world
A player can hold the weapon

needs_person: Firing, recoil, reloading with {magazine} and the sight picture. The gate has no fire action.
How the new texture looks in hands and on the ground.
questions: What display name and description should the weapon have?
New textures on the vanilla {parent} model, or a new model? This draft assumes new textures only.
Change any stats (fire modes, recoil, damage), or keep the {parent} values?
Where should it spawn, and how often?
